sql:
WITH order_values AS (
  SELECT
    o.orderid,
    o.customerid,
    c.buyinggroupid,
    c.customercategoryid,
    o.orderdate,
    SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unitprice) AS order_value
  FROM wideworldimporters.sales.orders o
  JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.orderlines ol ON ol.orderid = o.orderid
  LEFT JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.customers c ON c.customerid = o.customerid
  WHERE o.orderdate >= DATE '2024-11-29'
    AND o.orderdate < DATE '2024-11-30'
  GROUP BY o.orderid, o.customerid, c.buyinggroupid, c.customercategoryid, o.orderdate
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT
    ov.orderid,
    ov.order_value,
    CASE
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM wideworldimporters.sales.specialdeals sd
        WHERE ov.orderdate BETWEEN sd.startdate AND sd.enddate
          AND (
            sd.customerid = ov.customerid
            OR (sd.buyinggroupid IS NOT NULL AND sd.buyinggroupid = ov.buyinggroupid)
            OR (sd.customercategoryid IS NOT NULL AND sd.customercategoryid = ov.customercategoryid)
          )
      ) THEN 'With promotion'
      ELSE 'Without promotion'
    END AS promotion_status
  FROM order_values ov
)
SELECT
  promotion_status,
  COUNT(*) AS order_count,
  AVG(order_value) AS average_order_value
FROM flagged
GROUP BY promotion_status
ORDER BY promotion_status
LIMIT 500

sql:
SELECT o.orderid, o.customerid, o.orderdate, ol.orderlineid, ol.stockitemid, ol.description, ol.quantity, ol.unitprice, ol.taxrate, sd.specialdealid, sd.dealdescription, sd.discountamount, sd.discountpercentage, sd.unitprice AS dealunitprice, sd.startdate, sd.enddate
FROM wideworldimporters.sales.orders o
JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.customers c ON c.customerid = o.customerid
JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.orderlines ol ON ol.orderid = o.orderid
JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.specialdeals sd
  ON o.orderdate BETWEEN sd.startdate AND sd.enddate
  AND (sd.customerid IS NULL OR sd.customerid = o.customerid)
  AND (sd.buyinggroupid IS NULL OR sd.buyinggroupid = c.buyinggroupid)
  AND (sd.customercategoryid IS NULL OR sd.customercategoryid = c.customercategoryid)
  AND (
    sd.stockitemid = ol.stockitemid
    OR (sd.stockitemid IS NULL AND sd.stockgroupid IS NULL)
    OR (sd.stockitemid IS NULL AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM wideworldimporters.warehouse.stockitemstockgroups sg
      WHERE sg.stockitemid = ol.stockitemid
        AND sg.stockgroupid = sd.stockgroupid
    ))
  )
ORDER BY o.orderid, ol.orderlineid, sd.specialdealid
